mapper.select: SELECT DATE(create_time) stat_date, COUNT(1) total_add_count, COUNT(IF(last_send_time IS NOT NULL, 1, NULL)) total_send_count, COUNT(IF(last_send_time IS NOT NULL, 1, NULL)) / COUNT(1) send_ratio, COUNT(IF(last_send_time IS NOT NULL AND last_receive_time IS NOT NULL, 1, NULL)) send_reply_count, COUNT(IF(last_send_time IS NOT NULL AND last_receive_time IS NOT NULL, 1, NULL)) / COUNT(IF(last_send_time IS NOT NULL, 1, NULL)) send_reply_ratio, COUNT(IF(last_send_time IS NOT NULL AND last_receive_time IS NOT NULL, 1, NULL)) / COUNT(1) add_reply_ratio FROM tg_contact WHERE create_time >= #{startDate} GROUP BY stat_date ORDER BY stat_date DESC
